title: Pack + clean Denver apartment
description: Pack remaining belongings; deep clean per lease requirements; keep cleaning receipts if hiring a service. Photo/video documentation supports deposit recovery.

title: Move day · drive + inspect Long Beach unit
description: Denver → Long Beach: ~1,020 miles, ~15 hours driving (plan overnight stop). On arrival: pick up keys, document move-in condition with photos before unloading.

title: STATUTORY · CA tax residency note
description: Note your CA residency establishment date for next April's part-year CO + CA tax returns. The other statutory deadlines (driver's license, vehicle registration, voter re-registration) live as Address Updates so they each get their own deadline pill.
